headline: A 2019 executive order moves responsibility for government background investigations to the Department of Defense.
what_it_does: This executive order shifts the job of running background investigations to the Department of Defense. No summary was provided, so details are not available here, such as which agency handled this work before or how the change would be carried out.

who_it_affects.group: People who need government background investigations, such as federal job applicants and workers
who_it_affects.how: Their background investigations would be handled by the Department of Defense under this order.
The department takes on responsibility for conducting background investigations.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed April 24, 2019; the title does not give a timeline for the transfer.
